interpretation: VMAF, SSIM, and PSNR measure signal/background preservation and also penalize the intended face replacement.
Face-core pixel change confirms a visual effect, not correct identity similarity.
A definitive candidate comparison must replay the exact frozen decoded-frame corpus and use the same source identity, dimensions, frame count, and sample cadence.
